name: MyFonts
summary: Commercial font marketplace selling 400,000+ desktop and web fonts from independent foundries.
description: MyFonts is a commercial font marketplace where individual styles, family packages and bundles are bought with desktop, webfont, mobile app, e-document and digital ad/email licenses. Fonts are browsable by category (serif, sans serif, slab serif, script, display, handwritten) and refined with tag, foundry and designer search, and curated collections cover bestsellers, new releases, hot new fonts and special offers. The WhatTheFont tool identifies fonts from an uploaded image on web, iOS and Android.
contains: 400,000+ fonts for sale as single styles, family packages and bundles
collections: bestsellers (top 50, hourly), hot new fonts (last 50 days), bundles, special offers
browse by category and tag: serif, sans serif, slab serif, script, display, handwritten
license types: desktop, web font, mobile application, electronic document, digital ad/email
WhatTheFont identifies fonts from an uploaded image (web, iOS and Android)
localised in English, German, Spanish, French and Portuguese (Brazil)
